name: Kettlebell Windmill
steps: Press a light kettlebell overhead with one arm, feet wider than hips.
Turn both feet about 45 degrees away from the kettlebell side.
Push your hips toward the kettlebell side and hinge down.
Slide your free hand down the inside of your leg, eyes on the kettlebell.
Stand back up slowly, arm locked overhead.
cues: Arm locked, eyes on the bell
Push the hip out, then hinge
Breathe in down, out as you rise

common_mistakes.fix: Start light and keep the arm locked

common_mistakes.mistake: Rounding the back to reach lower
common_mistakes.fix: Only go as low as you keep a flat back
Keep the eyes on it the whole time
